name: Smooth Peanut Butter & Seedless Jelly Sandwich
whyItWorks: Creamy peanut butter and clear pectin jelly (grape or apple) on refined white or potato bread provide dense, zero-roughage calories with no nut shards or berry seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Use strictly creamy/smooth peanut butter (never crunchy) and seedless jelly (grape or apple — never raspberry/blackberry jam with seeds or orange marmalade) on soft white or potato bread.
watchOuts: Citrus marmalade or pectin with grapefruit extract
